4. World Almanac/NPCs/Nikolai Wachter (C: Fiona Wachter's thrill-seeking son, a nobleman of House Wachter; captured with his family at Vallaki.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Nimrie.md: Drow worshipper of Eilistraee at Duskferry who brought Faerah to Naerissa's shrine (S46); her own ties are undecided.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ostwin Reyes.md: The Tallyman: Ferrymen's Guild senior clerk secretly falsifying Duskferry manifests for Ascendency cargo bound for Greyfen Hollow.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Otto Belview (COS): Mongrelfolk Belview who guards the Abbey of Saint Markovia's north gate and digs up Krezk graves with Zygfrek.
Bildrath Cantemir's hulking nephew and stock boy, the muscle at Bildrath's Mercantile.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Patrina Velikovna: Dusk elf archmage and Kasimir's sister who taught Strahd the Amber Temple's secrets; bound to her crypt beneath Castle Ravenloft.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Piccolo (COS).md: Rictavio's former carnival monkey, given to Gadof Blinsky and trained as his shop assistant.
Strahd's murderous clockwork fool in Castle Ravenloft, who killed the real Pidlwick and longs for a friend.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Professor Alindra: The Umbral Athenaeum's gnome Councilor of Transmutation, an excitable inventor of magical alloys; met S45.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Professor Gousse W: Aarakocra Councilor of Conjuration at the Umbral Athenaeum studying the Barovian surge; planned giver of The Well of Many Worlds.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Rahadin (COS).md: Dead dusk elf chamberlain of Castle Ravenloft and honorary von Zarovich, Strahd's general for centuries; met S13 and S32.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Rictavio (COS).md: Rudolph van Richten disguised as a carnival ringmaster; vampire hunter and Ezmerelda's mentor, met S6-S34.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Rosavalda Rose Dur: Ghost of the elder Durst child at Death House, protective of her little brother Thorn.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Sangzor (COS).md: 'Bloodhorn,' the near-unkillable giant goat of Tsolenka Pass; its pelt earns the mountain berserkers' respect.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Savid (COS).md: Dead dusk elf under Kasimir's protection, met at Argynvostholt (S16); killed by a ghost while the party was away (S17).
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Seer Ithildra Moon: The Umbral Athenaeum's elf Councilor of Divination, famed for foreseeing a plague; studying the Barovian arcane surge.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Sir Godfrey Gwilym: Silver Dragon knight Strahd slew before his beloved Vladimir Horngaard; Redgrave learned in S17 that he was once Godfrey.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Stanimir (COS).md: Vistani wizard leading the Tser Pool caravan that guides fated strangers to Madam Eva.
Davian Martikov's daughter, a wereraven at the Wizard of Wines, married to Dag Tomescu.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Stella Wachter (CO: Fiona Wachter's daughter at Wachterhaus, broken by Victor Vallakovich's cruelty into believing she is a cat.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Strahd Von Zarovic: Vampire count of Barovia and master of Castle Ravenloft, destroyed by the party (S33); sometimes posed as Vasili von Holtz.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Strahds Animated A: Strahd's old war armor, animated to defend Castle Ravenloft; masterless now, still patrolling the parapets.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Szoldar Szoldarovi: Grim Vallaki wolf hunter, Yevgeni Krushkin's partner, selling wolf meat to feed his family; met S12.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/The Abbot (COS).md: Deva master of the Abbey of Saint Markovia who made the Belviews mongrelfolk and built Vasilka as Strahd's bride.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/The Mad Mage Of Mo: Mordenkainen, maddened former Circle of Eight leader, beaten by Strahd; his staff and spellbook lost at Tser Falls.
